import sqlite3

def get_recent_orders(db_path, date_str):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '{date_str}'")
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return results
